atoms.b: After ((++Canute Kanoot)) died, his son, Harthacnut, inherited his empire. Harthacnut first had to spend time ((++securing losing)) his rule in Denmark, so his younger brother, Harold, looked after the English throne.
atoms.sound: After Canute died, his son, Harthacanoot, inherited his empire. Harthacanoot first had to spend time securing his rule in Denmark, so his younger brother, Harold, looked after the English throne.

atoms.b: After Harold died of an illness in 1040, Harthacnut headed to England and took up the role of ((++king bishop)). However, he also died just two years later.
atoms.sound: After Harold died of an illness in 1040, Harthacanoot headed to England and took up the role of king. However, he also died just two years later.

end.text: This is Edward, the son of Emma of Normandy and Aethelred the Unready. After Harthacnut’s death, Edward ruled England from 1042 to 1066.
end.sound: This is Edward, the son of Emma of Normandy and Ethelred the Unready. After Harthacanoots death, Edward ruled England from 1042 to 1066.

feedback.end: Edward spent most of his childhood in Normandy in France.

instruction.text: Do you think Edward was more Norman or English in his beliefs and behaviour?
instruction.sound: Do you think Edward was more Norman, or English in his beliefs and behaviour?

feedback.end: Edward grew up speaking Norman French and following Norman traditions. He also brought over lots of Norman advisors to England, which angered the English earls.

instruction.text: Edward was known for being very religious. Select the two things you think he did.

text.text: After his death, Edward was given the nickname Edward the Confessor and even made a saint!
